verdict.rationale: Open-source client code is a fair thing to ask of an authenticator app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence says Authy's client apps are open source or open to inspection. The features page covers encryption and backups, and the community posts describe export difficulty, not source availability, so there is no support for the story.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the client apps are open source, so the code handling my seeds can be inspected and community-reviewed
